# InputBinding

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("InputBinding")`

One physical input that drives its parent `InputAction`. An action can have several bindings, and any of them triggers it: a key, a gamepad stick and an on-screen button can all drive the same action.

Which properties are used depends on the parent's `Type`. A `Bool` action uses `KeyCode`. A `Direction2D` action uses either a `KeyCode` that names a 2D input such as `LeftThumbstick`, or the four keys `Up`, `Down`, `Left` and `Right`. A binding whose properties do not fit its parent's type does nothing; it is not an error.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DeviceType` | `Enum.InputDeviceType` | — | read-only | The kind of device this binding belongs to, derived from `KeyCode`. Every input that is not a gamepad input reports `KeyboardMouse`, including `Unknown`. |
| `DisplayName` | `string` | `""` | read/write | The text a prompt shows for this binding. It can be a localization key, which lets the prompt be translated. When it is empty, a prompt should use the name of the key.<br><br>The engine does not use this value. A game reads it through `GetPreferredBinding` to draw its own prompts. |
| `Down` | `Enum.KeyCode` | `Enum.KeyCode.Unknown` | read/write | The key for -Y, used with `Up`. |
| `Image` | `Content` | `""` | read/write | An icon for this binding, as an `asset://` path. When it is empty, a prompt should show `DisplayName` instead.<br><br>The engine does not use this value or load the image. A game reads it through `GetPreferredBinding` and shows it in its own prompt, for example in an `ImageLabel`. |
| `KeyCode` | `Enum.KeyCode` | `Enum.KeyCode.Unknown` | read/write | The input this binding uses. `Unknown` means the binding is not bound. |
| `Left` | `Enum.KeyCode` | `Enum.KeyCode.Unknown` | read/write | The key for -X, used with `Right`. |
| `Right` | `Enum.KeyCode` | `Enum.KeyCode.Unknown` | read/write | The key for +X, used with `Left`. |
| `Scale` | `number` | `1` | read/write | A multiplier on the binding's value before it reaches the action. Use a small value for mouse look and 1 for a stick. A negative value inverts the axis, as an "invert Y" setting does. |
| `Up` | `Enum.KeyCode` | `Enum.KeyCode.Unknown` | read/write | The key for +Y on a `Direction1D` or `Direction2D` action. The four direction keys let a keyboard drive an axis: W, A, S and D are one binding, not four. |
